purpose: Wallet Service is the backend which keeps the balance of customers and lets them top up and send money to other wallets.

components.name: wallet-core
components.evidence: the business logic: balances, top-ups, transfers, profile

components.name: wallet-db (PostgreSQL)
components.evidence: store balances, transactions and the profile of owner

flows.evidence: the mobile app send wallet and transfer requests to the gateway
the gateway ask Keycloak for token validation
Wallet-core read and write balances and transactions in wallet-db
